newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slumps, U.S. fall makes arb marginal.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slumps, U.S. fall makes arb marginal.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices slumped on Wednesday, shedding over $10 a tonne as European and U.S. product futures tumbled.
Eurograde barges traded early at $212, but fell later to trade at $210, $209.50, $207 and $201.50 a tonne fob ARA, more than $10 down on Tuesday's traded levels.
A 30,000 tonne premium unleaded cargo was sold to the U.S. on Tuesday at a 5-6 cent discount to Jan NYMEX, fob Antwerp.
But U.S. gasoline futures have shed some $30 a tonne in the last two days, and traders said the transatlantic arbitrage was now marginal.
"The falls on NYMEX make it difficult to ship products to the States unless you think it is unsellable in Europe...then it's the lesser of two evils." said one trader.
U.S. gasoline prices came under pressure from bearish weekly U.S. stocks data. API figures showed a 5.9 million barrel build in gasoline stocks, while EIA data showed a 4.2 million barrel increase.
